name: synloq
description: Local coordination between visible project role chats.
author: Synloq contributors
skillInstructions: Initialize and coordinate arbitrary visible project role chats. Use only the MCP channel assigned to the current role. Acknowledge only after actual reading, reply in the original thread, and request operator approval for risky actions.

interface.longDescription: Initialize arbitrary project roles and coordinate their ordinary visible Kimi Work chats through authenticated local channels.
tryPrompts: Send a bounded question to another project role.
Reply in the original Synloq thread after reading.
